groups.defect: Unguarded access to integration.metadata["sender"]["login"] can crash installation instead of returning the invalid-request error.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same metadata dereference and request a guard for absent sender information.

groups.defect: The reports identify an incorrect request limit, an unnecessary search scheduling wrapper, inconsistent sanitization naming, an unsuitable analytics timer, an incorrect API HTTP method, and mismatched form field binding.
groups.rationale: Despite different anchors and summaries, all seven bodies repeat the identical six-problem report. The merged comment must preserve the distinct changes across those locations.

groups.defect: OAuth token exchange and user-info lookup execute outside exception handling, allowing network or API failures to produce a 500 instead of the error page.
groups.rationale: Both report the same unhandled calls in OAuthLoginView.dispatch; one exception-handling block covering both operations addresses both reports.
